result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments from the comments list. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been checked.

- **API:** the new `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends the new body as `PATCH /comments/{commentId}`. After saving, it refreshes the comments list.
- **Success message:** the hook shows a "Comment Updated" notification itself. I put it there instead of in the component because `docs/api-layer.md` says feature components never call `useNotifications`.
- **Edit button and drawer:** the new `components/update-comment.tsx` is an Edit button that opens a drawer with a form pre-filled with the current body.
- **Own comments only:** I added a `comment:update` policy in `lib/authorization.tsx` that passes only when the comment's author is the current user. Admins can still delete any comment but only see Edit on their own.
- **Placement:** the Edit button sits beside Delete in `comments-list.tsx`. It is only rendered inside the existing delete-permission wrapper, which is fine because the author always passes that check.
- **Mock backend:** I added a `PATCH /comments/:commentId` handler to the MSW comments handlers, restricted to the comment's author. Without it the dev app and tests would get no response.

I didn't add a test for the new flow.
